summary: feat(settings): add email-first page prototypes to Storybook
description:
## Because

- We want to compare very different layouts for the email-first page before we pick a direction.
- In Storybook, anyone can open the prototypes and resize them, which a screenshot does not allow.

## This pull request

- Adds three static prototypes of the email-first page in `prototypes/index.tsx`: `SplitHero`, `Conversational`, and `MethodChooser`.
- Adds `prototypes/index.stories.tsx`, which shows them under `Pages/Index/Prototypes`.
- Reuses the existing Google, Apple, and passkey icons, the Mozilla logo, and the Sync clouds graphic.

## Issue that this pull request solves
